fee_notes: Royalty minimum is $350/month for first 12 months, then $1,000/month. Local advertising is greater of 2% gross revenues or $1,500/month. National Branding Contribution is 2% of gross revenues or $350/month minimum. Local cooperative advertising up to 3% of gross revenues if cooperative established.
